title: Social confidence
learning_outcomes: Explain confidence versus skill in the context of social confidence.
Compare and distinguish voluntary graded practice in the context of social confidence.
Apply feedback in the context of social confidence.
Evaluate and justify decisions about support needs in the context of social confidence.

lessons.title: Confidence versus skill
lessons.outcome: Explain confidence versus skill in the context of social confidence.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving confidence versus skill; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to low-stakes practice plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain confidence versus skill from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of confidence versus skill; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Voluntary graded practice
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish voluntary graded practice in the context of social confidence.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving voluntary graded practice; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to low-stakes practice plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain voluntary graded practice from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of voluntary graded practice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Feedback
lessons.outcome: Apply feedback in the context of social confidence.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving feedback; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to low-stakes practice plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain feedback from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of feedback; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Support needs
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about support needs in the context of social confidence.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving support needs; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to low-stakes practice plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain support needs from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of support needs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of confidence versus skill; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of voluntary graded practice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of feedback; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of support needs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
